meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 它会拷贝 Slack 适配器并完成注册、安装固定版本依赖、构建并跑注册测试,再引导你创建 Slack 应用、填写凭据、解析你的私信频道并重启服务,让 Claude 能在 Slack 频道和私信里收发消息。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加 Slack 频道集成时运行。技能会先问事件投递方式(Socket Mode 或 webhook),再引导创建 Slack 应用、填写凭据并重启服务。

say.text: 帮我加上 Slack 集成
say.note: 会先问用 Socket Mode 还是 webhook

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 接入 Slack
say.note: 不需要公网 URL,适合本机或 NAT 后

say.text: 用 webhook 方式接 Slack,公网映射 3000 端口
say.note: 需要公网 HTTPS 的 Request URL

howto.what_en: It copies the Slack adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned package, builds and runs the registration test, then walks you through creating a Slack app, storing tokens and restarting the service.
howto.when_en: Runs when you want to add Slack channel integration to NanoClaw. It asks how Slack should deliver events — Socket Mode or webhook — then guides you through the app setup, credentials and a restart.

say_en.note: asks Socket Mode or webhook first

say_en.text: Connect Slack via webhook on port 3000
say_en.note: needs a public HTTPS Request URL
